messages:
carmen: Quick follow-up from the PM and postmortem: recurring short spikes are draining GPU headroom and causing autoscaler thrash. We need owners and concrete short-term fixes + ETAs so we can move items into the remediation tracker. Keep replies concise.

li: TL;DR: 20-90s bursts -> scheduler doesn't recycle leases fast enough and autoscaler reacts too slowly -> queue pileups and transient p99 SLA blips. Seen on multi-tenant evals and interactive workloads.

carmen: Proposed Action 1: Short-lease mode for scheduler (30s micro-lease path) to favor quick turnover for short jobs. Owner: @li. ETA: 2026-04-09 (P0). Acceptance: during synthetic 60s bursts, 95th queue depth <= baseline 75th percentile.

li: I'll add telemetry for micro_lease_attempts, micro_lease_success, avg_micro_lease_dur and push to headroom.* namespace. ETA for metrics & dashboard: 2026-03-29.

devin: Action 2: Routing-layer soft backstop (per-tenant short-term cap) to prevent single tenant from reserving >45% for >45s. Owner: @devin. ETA: 2026-04-03 (P1). Acceptance: tenant-induced headroom events reduce by >=50% in tests.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: planned canary: scheduler-micro-lease -> shadow on perf-cluster 2026-03-31T02:00Z (CI#14321).

carmen: Action 3: Headroom alert + one-click "surge relief" toggle in Console (ops paging + temporary fairness enforcement). Owner: @carmen. ETA: 2026-03-27. Acceptance: alert fires <10s and toggle reduces tenant skew by >=50% in shadow.

devin: I'll coordinate billing check for any pre-warm or reserved resource changes with finance. Tagging Finance in the tracker. ETA: 2026-03-31.

li: Test plan for micro-lease: 1) synthetic bursts at 2x and 5x for 10m windows, 2) measure tail latency & GPU utilization variance, 3) compare to control. I'll post notebooks and artifacts. ETA: 2026-04-06.

carmen: Runbook updates needed: add "burst triage" steps, CLI checks, and emergency rollback. Who owns runbook?

devin: I'll own the runbook edits and include CLI snippets. ETA: 2026-03-26. Example snippet for triage to include:
```
# quick headroom triage
redwoodctl metrics query --ns headroom --metric headroom_free_gpus --window 30s
redwoodctl sched leases --cluster perf --last 10m
```

remediation-bot: task-bot: TASK-90021 "micro-lease canary + metrics" created and assigned: li, due 2026-04-09.

carmen: Suggest cadence: daily one-line status until tasks are moved to in-progress, plus a 30-min weekly sync for 6 weeks post-rollout. I'll schedule the recurring.

li: ack :white_check_mark:

devin: ack :thumbsup:

carmen: Thanks — I'll add these owners and acceptance criteria to the remediation tracker now.
